mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL ACCOMPANY TSTM ACTIVITY ACROSS GA AND SC THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR/SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGEST A WEAK MID-LEVEL DISTURBANCE HAS MIGRATED INTO NRN GA. CONVECTION IS INCREASING AND INTENSIFYING INVOF THIS FEATURE WHERE 500MB TEMPERATURES ARE SEASONALLY COOL NEAR -8C. ADEQUATE SFC-6KM BULK SHEAR IS PRESENT FOR MULTI-CELL CLUSTERING IN THE PRESENCE OF AFOREMENTIONED DISTURBANCE. FOR THIS REASON IT APPEARS AN UPWARD-EVOLVING CORRIDOR OF CONVECTION WILL BE NOTED FROM WCTNRL GA INTO WRN SC OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE ALONG LEADING EDGE OF MCS OVER WW335.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEADING EDGE OF LONG-LIVED MCS HAS PROGRESSED TO NEAR THE MS RIVER WITH APEX OF BOW-TYPE SQUALL LINE APPROACHING THE IL/MO/KY BORDER REGION. THIS ACTIVITY IS PROPAGATING EAST AT 35KT...PERHAPS A BIT QUICKER. NUMEROUS SHOWERS/TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED AHEAD OF THIS STRONGER BAND OF STORMS OVER KY AND THIS COULD OVERTURN INSTABILITY PRIOR TO SQUALL LINE ARRIVAL. EVEN SO...DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH THE MOST ORGANIZED CONVECTION. NEW WW MAY BE REQUIRED DOWNSTREAM TO ACCOUNT FOR NEW DEVELOPMENT. ..DARROW.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY DAMAGING THUNDERSTORM WINDS POSSIBLE AS CONVECTION RESTRENGTHENS AND MOVES EASTWARD ACROSS OHIO AND NORTHEAST KENTUCKY
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REMNANT CONVECTION IS RE-INTENSIFYING AHEAD OF OVERNIGHT CONVECTIVELY GENERATED COLD POOL ALONG AN AXIS FROM COLUMBUS IN NORTH CENTRAL OHIO SOUTHWARD TO ILN TO NEAR FFT IN KENTUCKY. MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH SBCAPE RANGING FROM 2500 TO 3500 J/KG COMBINED WITH DEEP LAYER WESTERLY FLOW AOA 20 KTS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO LOCALLY INTENSE CONVECTIVE CORES SUPPORTING LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND THREAT. SOME MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE WITH MOST INTENSE CONVECTIVE CORES. ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO INTENSIFY AND WORK EASTWARD ACROSS THE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED LARGE HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY CONVECTION AS IT SPREADS SEWD ACROSS SERN MT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LARGE-SCALE FORCING APPEARS TO BE INCREASING ACROSS ERN MT AHEAD OF STRONG SHORT-WAVE TROUGH. CONVECTION IS SLOWLY INCREASING/INTENSIFYING OVER GARFIELD/NRN ROSEBUD/PRAIRIE COUNTY REGION AND THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD CONTINUE PROPAGATING SEWD TOWARD A MORE BUOYANT AIR MASS. LATEST MRMS DATA SUGGESTS SEVERE HAIL ACCOMPANIES THE MOST ROBUST UPDRAFTS WITHIN THIS DEVELOPING CLUSTER. THERE IS INCREASING CONCERN THAT UPWARD-EVOLVING SMALL COMPLEX OF STORMS COULD SPREAD INTO SWRN ND/NWRN SD OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS WW336.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WEAK MID-LEVEL DISTURBANCE CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY DRIFT EAST ACROSS NRN GA...ROUGHLY NEAR CLARKE COUNTY GA AT 19Z. STRONG CONVECTION HAS DEVELOPED AHEAD OF THIS FEATURE...ORIENTED IN A NE-SW FASHION FROM NWRN SC...SWWD INTO SERN AL. PRECIPITATION-INDUCED COLD POOL THAT HAS DEVELOPED OVER NRN GA SHOULD AID SE SURGE ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF WW. ..DARROW.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A DAMAGING WIND THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE EWD TO THE ATLANTIC COAST. SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE NEEDED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROKEN LINE OF CONVECTION EXTENDS FROM CNTRL SC SWWD INTO MUCH OF CNTRL GA AS OF 1940Z. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE MOVING EWD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF SERN GA...ERN SC...AND FAR SERN NC OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM OF THIS ACTIVITY IS STRONGLY UNSTABLE...WITH RAP MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATING MLCAPE GENERALLY IN THE 2000-3000 J/KG RANGE. STRONG TO LOCALLY DAMAGING DOWNDRAFT WINDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE THE MAIN THREAT...ALTHOUGH RELATIVELY COOL MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES /-8 DEG C AT 500 MB PER 12Z FFC SOUNDING/ MAY ALSO SUPPORT A ISOLATED LARGE HAIL THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED BY 21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: HIGH-BASED CONVECTION HAS RECENTLY DEVELOPED BENEATH THICKER CIRRUS WITHIN SW-NE ORIENTED WARM CONVEYOR OVER NERN WY INTO THE NRN SLOPES OF THE BLACK HILLS OF SD. THE NON-TERRAIN-INDUCED CONVECTION OVER WY IS LIKELY DRIVEN BY LARGE-SCALE PROCESSES AHEAD OF STRONG SHORT-WAVE TROUGH. LATEST SATELLITE/SFC DATA SUGGEST MORE MOIST BOUNDARY-LAYER IS STREAMING NWWD INTO THE EASTERN PORTION OF THE BLACK HILLS WHERE SFC DEW POINTS ARE NOW NEAR 60F. WHILE 18Z SOUNDING AT RAP SUGGESTS SFC-BASED PARCELS REMAIN CAPPED ALONG THE I-90 CORRIDOR...INTENSE HEATING OVER SERN WY APPEARS TO BE RESPONSIBLE FOR NEW DEVELOPMENT OVER DAWES COUNTY NEBRASKA. CONTINUED DEEPENING/STRENGTHENING OF THIS AGITATED CU FIELD SHOULD LEAD TO STRONG SUPERCELLS WITHIN A FEW HOURS. WHILE HAIL WILL BE COMMON WITH THESE STORMS...TORNADO THREAT SHOULD INCREASE AS STORM INFLOW BECOMES INCREASINGLY MOIST.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG THE DRYLINE SOON. LARGE HAIL AND WIND ARE LIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NUMEROUS HIGH-BASED CU HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS FROM SERN WY INTO NERN CO. SEVERAL UPDRAFTS HAVE PENETRATED LEVELS TO GLACIATE AND LIGHTNING IS NOW OBSERVED OVER LINCOLN COUNTY CO. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS MORE THAN ADEQUATE FOR SUPERCELLS AS THESE UPDRAFTS ENCOUNTER INCREASINGLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER. LARGE HAIL AND WIND WILL BE COMMON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL AND WIND APPEARS LIKELY ACROSS PARTS OF THE TX PANHANDLE AND S PLAINS...POSSIBLY EXTENDING INTO FAR WRN OK THIS EVENING. AT THIS TIME...COVERAGE APPEARS TOO LOW FOR A WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: HOT TEMPERATURES HAVE RESULTED IN DRY ADIABATIC LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND A LARGE AREA OF CU ERUPTING WITHING THE SFC TROUGH. MOISTURE REMAINS IMPRESSIVE DESPITE TEMPERATURES OVER 100 F WHICH IS YIELDING MUCAPE VALUES OF 2000-2500 ALONG AN AMARILLO TO LUBBOCK LINE. FORECAST 40+ KT 850 FLOW THIS EVENING OUT OF THE S ALONG WITH MODEST 25-30 KT MIDLEVEL FLOW SHOULD SUPPORT A THREAT OF STRONG TO PERHAPS SEVERE STORMS WELL INTO THE EVENING AS THEY DRIFT SLOWLY EWD. IF COVERAGE OF THE MORE INTENSE CORES INCREASES BEYOND WHAT IS CURRENTLY EXPECTED...THEN A WATCH MAY NEED TO BE RECONSIDERED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MCS MOVING THROUGH SOUTH-CENTRAL KY AND MIDDLE TN MAY CONTINUE TO POSE A STRONG TO DMGG WIND THREAT ACROSS WW 337. ADDITIONAL LESS-ORGANIZED TSTMS ARE PERSISTING INTO ERN TN AND SERN KY...WITH ISOLATED STRONG TO MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUSTS POSSIBLE. ALTHOUGH A NEW WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...CONVECTIVE TRENDS CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED PULSE TO LOOSELY ORGANIZED CONVECTION IS SLOWLY SPREADING EWD ACROSS MIDDLE TN AND CNTRL KY...AHEAD OF A MORE ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE LINE FARTHER TO THE W. REGIONAL VWP DATA CONTINUE TO INDICATE MODEST MIDLEVEL FLOW /20-30 KT/ IS PRESENT...AND WITH THE DEGREE OF BOUNDARY-LAYER HEATING AND STEEPENING OF LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES THAT HAVE OCCURRED...ISOLATED STRONG TO MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE. THE RELATIVELY MORE WIDESPREAD SVR THREAT MAY CONTINUE TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH MCS FROM SOUTH-CENTRAL KY INTO MIDDLE TN...BUT LATEST RADAR SCANS SHOWS DEVELOPING CONVECTION OCCURRING WELL BEHIND OUTFLOW. SCATTERED TSTMS DEVELOPING AHEAD OF THE LINE MAY ALSO LIMIT THE POTENTIAL FOR INTENSIFICATION OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS. RADAR TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF INCREASING ORGANIZATION/MAGNITUDE OF THE DMGG WIND THREAT...IN WHICH CASE A NEW WATCH WOULD BE POSSIBLE. ..ROGERS.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES...DAMAGING WINDS...AND HAIL PERSISTS FROM CNTRL SD INTO NEB THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL INTENSE CLUSTERS OF SEVERE STORMS ARE CURRENTLY ONGOING AS OF 00Z...ONE ACROSS W CNTRL SD WHERE SUPERCELLS HAVE TRANSITIONED INTO A SMALL SEVERE BOW...AND ACROSS NRN NEB WITH A TORNADIC SUPERCELL ONGOING OVER CHERRY COUNTY. JUST NE OF THE TORNADIC CELL WAS ANOTHER SEVERE BOW. SUBSTANTIAL INSTABILITY EXISTS DOWNSTREAM OF THESE STORMS WHICH WILL CONTINUE TO FAVOR UPSCALE GROWTH WITH THE MAIN THREAT TRANSITIONING INTO DAMAGING STRAIGHT LINE WINDS. STORMS WILL BE AIDED BY AN INCREASING SLY LOW-LEVEL JET...WHICH MAY ALSO RESULT IN A VEERING OF THE STORM MOTION DUE TO PROPAGATION. ADDITIONAL WATCHES MAY BE REQUIRED ACROSS MUCH OF ERN NEB AND SERN SD LATE THIS EVENING. ..JEWELL.. 07/06/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR STRONG TO MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUSTS MAY EXIST FOR THE NEXT COUPLE HRS INTO THE WRN CAROLINAS...FAR NWRN GA...AND SWRN VA. A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL LOOSELY ORGANIZED TSTM CLUSTERS ARE SPREADING EWD ACROSS THE SRN APPALACHIANS THIS EVENING...WHERE THE AIR MASS REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE AMIDST TEMPERATURES IN THE MID-UPPER 80S F. MRX VWP DATA HAS SHOWED A STRENGTHENING IN 0-3 KM LAYER FLOW TO 30-40 KT WITHIN THE PAST COUPLE HRS. THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG TO MARGINALLY SVR DOWNBURST WINDS MAY CONTINUE TO ACCOMPANY ONGOING TSTMS /KRHP SAMPLED A 54 KT GUST AROUND 23Z/ ACROSS THE WRN CAROLINAS INTO SWRN VA AND NWRN GA...BUT THE IMMINENT LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING SHOULD LIMIT THE POTENTIAL FOR ANY SUBSTANTIAL INTENSIFICATION OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS...AND WILL LIKELY PRECLUDE WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SVR WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS PARTS OF SWRN OK AND NW TX THIS EVENING. GIVEN THE VERY ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT...A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL CLUSTER OF TSTMS MOVING ACROSS THE LOWER ROLLING PLAINS AND FAR SERN PANHANDLE OF TX WITH A HISTORY OF PRODUCING ISOLATED 60-70 MPH WIND GUSTS CONTINUES TO MOVE EWD INTO SWRN OK AND NW TX. LOW-MIDLEVEL FLOW IS MARGINAL /10-20 KT PER AMA AND OUN 00Z SOUNDINGS/...BUT SUFFICIENT TO SUSTAIN ORGANIZED CONVECTION GIVEN THE RICH BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE AND STEEP LOW-MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES IN PLACE. THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED SVR WIND GUSTS SHOULD CONTINUE OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HRS OR SO...BEFORE AN ANTICIPATED WEAKENING TREND ASSOCIATED WITH THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING OCCURS. WATCH ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY GIVEN THE ISOLATED AND SHORT-LIVED NATURE OF THIS THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT OF SEVERE WINDS AND HAIL IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST THIS EVENING INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS AND A NEW WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS OVER CNTRL NEB HAVE CONGEALED INTO CLUSTERS AND A FURTHER CONSOLIDATION IS EXPECTED AS OUTFLOWS BECOME LINKED OVER TIME. THE AIR MASS REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE OVER 3000 J/KG AND AMPLE MOISTURE TO SUPPORT OUTFLOW PRODUCTION. MEAN WLY FLOW ALOFT AND AN INCREASING SWLY LOW-LEVEL JET MAY RESULT IN A RIGHTWARD TURNING OF THE MCS...ASSUMING CIN DOES NOT INCREASE TOO MUCH. THEREFORE...PARTS OF NERN KS...NWRN MO...AND SWRN IA MAY EVENTUALLY SEE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: BOWING LINE OF STORMS MAY PRODUCE SEVERE WIND GUSTS AS THIS LINE ADVANCES TO THE EAST-SOUTHEAST ACROSS PARTS OF NORTHERN AND CENTRAL IA OVERNIGHT. WW ISSUANCE IS BEING CONSIDERED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE STREAMLINE AND OBSERVATIONAL ANALYSES INDICATED A BOUNDARY EXTENDING GENERALLY TO THE EAST ACROSS NORTHERN IA FROM NEAR THE APEX OF A BOWING LINE OF STORMS. THOSE STORMS WERE LOCATED IN NORTHWEST IA PER MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY...WHILE THE BOUNDARY EXTENDED THROUGH HAMILTON COUNTY TO THE VICINITY OF FAR EAST-CENTRAL IOWA. RICH MOISTURE AVAILABLE DOWNSTREAM AND A GRADIENT OF MODERATELY STRONG INSTABILITY /MUCAPE OF 2000-3000 J PER KG/ EXTENDING W-E EITHER SIDE OF THIS BOUNDARY AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /H7-H5 OF 8-8.5 C PER KM/ SUGGEST THE ONGOING BOWING LINE OF STORMS WILL PROGRESS TO THE EAST-SOUTHEAST OVERNIGHT. FOR THE LAST HOUR...MEASURED SURFACE WIND GUSTS HAVE BEEN SUB-SEVERE AS THIS BOW ADVANCED ACROSS THESE OBSERVATION SITES IN FAR NORTHWEST IA. ALTHOUGH SOME AFOREMENTIONED FACTORS AND FAST MOVEMENT OF THE BOW /ESE AT 40 KT/ WOULD SUGGEST A DAMAGING WIND THREAT ACROSS NORTHERN AND CENTRAL IA...THE STABILIZATION OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER MAY BE SUFFICIENT TO LESSEN THAT SEVERE-WEATHER THREAT. OPERATIONAL HRRR DOES NOT REPRESENT THE ONGOING STORM STRUCTURE AND LOCATION...WHILE THE 00Z 4-KM WRF-NMM SUGGESTS THIS BOW ADVANCES ACROSS IA THAT WOULD WARRANT A WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A BOWING LINE OF STORMS...WITH THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE DAMAGING WINDS...WILL ADVANCE TO THE EAST ACROSS SOUTHEAST NEBRASKA...NORTHEAST KANSAS...THROUGH FAR SOUTHERN IOWA AND NORTHERN MISSOURI /POTENTIALLY INCLUDING PARTS OF THE KANSAS CITY METRO AREA/.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SINCE 05Z...TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED DEVELOPING AND ELONGATING BOWING LINE OF STORMS ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL NEB INTO ADJACENT NORTH-CENTRAL KS...WITH THIS LINE MOVING TO THE EAST/EAST-SOUTHEAST AT CLOSE TO 40 KT. THE ENVIRONMENT IS MORE UNSTABLE THAN FARTHER NORTH INTO IA...WITH AVAILABLE MUCAPE RANGING FROM 3000-5000 J/KG FROM KS INTO NORTHERN MO. THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT EXTENDED EAST FROM THE ONGOING SOUTHERN NEB/NORTHERN KS BOW INTO NORTHERN MO...WHILE A STRENGTHENING SWLY LLJ /UP TO 40-45 KT/ EXTENDED FROM THE SOUTHERN PLAINS THROUGH THE EASTERN HALF OF KS INTO NORTHERN MO. WAA AT THE NOSE OF THIS LLJ AND FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO AN APPARENT SHORTWAVE TROUGH TRACKING TO THE EAST ACROSS NEB PER VAD WIND ANALYSIS WILL SUPPORT THIS MCS PROGRESSING OVERNIGHT TO THE EAST. IN ADDITION...RECENT VAD WINDS AT UEX SHOWED A WELL-FORMED REAR-INFLOW JET WITH THIS STRENGTHENING BOW /WESTERLY AT 50+ KT/ BETWEEN 2-5 KM AGL...AND 40-45 KT IN THE LOWEST LEVELS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE-WEATHER THREAT ASSOCIATED WITH A QLCS EXTENDING FROM SOUTHWEST IA THROUGH SOUTHEAST NEB TO NORTH-CENTRAL KS ALREADY HAS OR WILL HAVE EXITED ALL OF WW 343 BY 08Z. HOWEVER...ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE ELEVATED STORMS WILL REMAIN A RISK FOR HAIL AND/OR LOCALLY STRONG WING GUSTS ACROSS MAINLY THE SOUTHERN HALF OF THIS WATCH BEYOND 08Z. A PORTION OF THIS WATCH MAY NEED TO BE EXTENDED TEMPORALLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0715Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED ALL BUT THE TRAILING SECTION OF THE IA/SOUTHEAST NEB/FAR NORTHERN KS QLCS HAD ALREADY EXITED WW 343. ALTHOUGH THIS DATA SUGGEST THE WATCH COULD BE CANCELED SOON OR AS SCHEDULED AT 08Z...A FEW ELEVATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS THE SOUTHERN HALF OF WW 343 DURING THE OVERNIGHT. THESE STORMS WILL BE FORMING NORTH OF AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDS WESTWARD FROM THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF THE AFOREMENTIONED QLCS THROUGH THE NORTHERN EXTENT OF NORTH-CENTRAL TO NORTHWEST KS. WAA ATTENDANT TO A STRONG S/SWLY LLJ /50-60 KT PER AMA/DDC VADS/ AND AN INFLUX OF MODERATELY STRONG MUCAPE 2000-3000 J/KG LOCATED ACROSS WESTERN KS SUGGEST ADDITIONAL /MAINLY EPISODIC/ STORM INTENSITY INCREASES WILL BE POSSIBLE. TRENDS IN MRMS DATA CONFIRM THE EPISODIC NATURE OF THESE STORMS WITH MESH SUGGESTING HAIL AT TIMES POTENTIALLY EXCEEDING 1 INCH IN DIAMETER. ..PETERS.. 07/07/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE-WEATHER THREAT WILL CONTINUE TO DIMINISH ACROSS WW 344 WITH MOST OF THE COUNTIES BEING CANCELED EARLY FROM THE WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0845Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED THE STRONGEST REFLECTIVITY LOCATED IN THE FAR NORTHEAST PORTION OF WW 344 AND EXTENDING POLEWARD INTO SOUTHEAST MN. HOWEVER...THE POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS ATTENDANT TO THIS LINE OF STORMS WILL DECREASE FURTHER AS THIS ACTIVITY ADVANCES INTO A MORE STABLE ENVIRONMENT TO THE EAST AND NORTHEAST. FARTHER SOUTH INTO CENTRAL IA...THE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY HAS BEEN MOVING AHEAD OF THE STORMS...WITH THIS PORTION OF THE OUTFLOW BEING SIMILAR TO AN ANAFRONT AS ANY NEW CONVECTION DEVELOPS ATOP THE COLD POOL. THESE TRENDS AND OBSERVATIONS FAVOR THE LIKELIHOOD FOR MUCH...IF NOT ALL...OF THIS WATCH BEING CANCELED EARLY. ..PETERS.. 07/07/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FAST-MOVING BOWING LINE OF STORMS WILL PRODUCE ADDITIONAL SEVERE/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AS THE STORMS FROM THE APEX SOUTHWESTWARD CONTINUE TO MAKE A TURN TO THE SOUTHEAST ACROSS NORTHERN MO AND NORTHEAST KS...WHILE THE NORTHERN PORTION TRACKS EAST ALONG EITHER SIDE OF THE MO/IA BORDER. COUNTIES IN THE WAKE OF THIS BOW CAN BE REMOVED FROM THE WATCH WITH ITS PASSAGE...THOUGH KS COUNTIES WEST OF THE LINE OF STORMS MAY NEED TO BE MAINTAINED IN WW 345...GIVEN ANY ELEVATED STORMS THAT POSE A POTENTIAL SEVERE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0910Z...TRENDS IN RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED THE BOWING LINE OF STORMS MOVING INTO THE CENTRAL PARTS OF WW 345 HAD ACCELERATED IN FORWARD SPEED /CLOSE TO 50 KT WITH THE APEX OF THE LINE/. MEANWHILE...ACCELERATIONS ALSO OCCURRED ALONG THE REST OF THE LINE OF STORMS...WITH THE SOUTHERN EXTENT IN NORTHEAST KS MOVING TO THE SOUTHEAST AT 35-40 KT...AND THE NORTHERN PORTION MOVING EAST AT 40 KT ALONG EITHER SIDE OF THE MO/IA BORDER AREA. THESE CURRENT SPEEDS SUGGEST THE LINE OF STORMS WILL EXIT MUCH OF THIS WATCH BETWEEN 11-1130Z. ONGOING AND DOWNSTREAM TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR NEW WW ISSUANCE. ...MO/NORTHEAST KS... THE PORTION OF THIS BOWING LINE FROM THE APEX SOUTHWESTWARD BEGAN A TURN TO THE SOUTHEAST AS THE APEX MOVED THROUGH FAR SOUTHEAST NEB...WHERE FALL CITY /FNB/ REPORTED A WIND GUST OF 59 KT AT 0813Z. THIS SOUTHEAST TURN IS EXPECTED TO BE MAINTAINED THROUGH THE REST OF THE EARLY MORNING...GIVEN A NW-SE ORIENTATION OF A MODERATELY STRONG INSTABILITY GRADIENT. ADDITIONAL COUNTIES MAY BE ADDED...AS NEEDED...TO THIS WATCH IN NORTHEAST KS AS THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF THE LINE MOVES TOWARD THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF WW 345. ...FAR NORTHERN MO/FAR SOUTHERN IA... THE NORTHERN PORTION OF THE LINE OF STORMS IS EXPECTED TO MAINTAIN A MORE EASTWARD MOVEMENT AS THIS ACTIVITY TENDS TO DEVELOP EAST ALONG THE TRAILING W-E ORIENTATION OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...ATTENDANT TO THE IA/SOUTHERN MN MCS. THE CURRENT EASTWARD SPEED OF THIS LINE AT 40 KT SUGGESTS LOCALLY STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN A THREAT. ..PETERS.. 07/07/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE/DAMAGING WIND THREAT CONTINUES TO AFFECT NORTHEAST KS AND NORTHWEST MO /INCLUDING THE KANSAS CITY METRO AREA/. A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS LIKELY TO THE EAST AND SOUTHEAST OF WW 345 TO INCLUDE A LARGE PORTION OF MO INTO ADJACENT PARTS OF WESTERN AND SOUTHERN IL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE FASTEST PORTION OF A BOWING LINE OF STORMS WAS MOVING THROUGH THE KANSAS CITY METRO AND NORTHEAST KS WITH THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF THE LINE HAVING A RECENT INCREASE IN FORWARD SPEED TO 40-45 KT...WHILE THE NORTHWEST MO PORTION MAINTAINED A TRACK TO THE SOUTHEAST AT AROUND 45 KT. AN INSTABILITY GRADIENT EXTENDED FROM NORTHWEST TO SOUTHEAST DOWNSTREAM OF THE BOWING LINE SUGGESTING THE SOUTHEAST MOVEMENT WILL PERSIST. SEVERE AND NEAR-SEVERE WIND GUSTS HAVE OCCURRED WITHIN WW 345 /FOE /TOPEKA-FORBES FIELD/ GUSTED TO 63 KT AT 0940Z...WHILE MKC PEAK WIND WAS 48 KT AT 0948Z AND LXT PEAK WIND WAS 47 KT AT 1007Z/. GIVEN THESE TRENDS AND THE FAVORABLE INSTABILITY GRADIENT...A NEW WW WILL BE COORDINATED AND ISSUED TO THE EAST AND SOUTHEAST OF WW 345. MEANWHILE...FARTHER NORTH...A CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY HAS MOVED INTO THE FAR NORTHEAST EXTENT OF WW 345...AHEAD OF THE EASTWARD-MOVING NORTH-SOUTH ORIENTED LINE OF STORMS. THIS TREND WOULD SUGGEST THE OVERALL SEVERE-WEATHER THREAT MAY DIMINISH ACROSS FAR SOUTHERN IA AS THE ENVIRONMENT UNDERGOES FURTHER CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING/STABILIZATION.
